_readme: Models and effort per tier. After editing, run: python3 .claude/skills/orchestrate/scripts/sync_models.py. model: an alias (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku = latest of that family) or a full ID such as claude-opus-5-5 to pin a version. effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max. stats.enabled: write a stats.json per run (see scripts/stats.py).
